hacking.comparison_establishes: One string mismatch under case/whitespace folding.
hacking.diagnostic_relation: Removing the vendor prefix from the submitted product-name string yields equality under that comparison.
hacking.limits: Does not establish software identity equivalence or justify dropping qualifiers from retained evidence.

hacking.comparison_establishes: One complete-string mismatch under case/whitespace folding.
hacking.diagnostic_relation: The parsed signed offsets and daylight/standard zone-label phrases agree; complete rendered strings differ.
hacking.limits: No standard-versus-daylight choice error or offset disagreement is demonstrated. Physical clock accuracy, actual DST state and registry interpretation remain unvalidated.

hacking.comparison_establishes: One parsed timestamp mismatch under zero tolerance.
hacking.diagnostic_relation: Submission retains fractional seconds; reference is whole-second precision. Removing fractional seconds yields the same instant, without a remaining timezone/hour shift.
hacking.limits: Does not authorize truncation or changing tolerance, and does not independently validate source-time interpretation.

data_leakage.comparison_establishes: Five browser-label atoms and three artifact-path atoms fail the frozen string comparison.
data_leakage.supported_generic_cause: Native validated-container labels and selected locations disagree with legacy strings/list entries; saved bindings carry the public browser/path roles.
data_leakage.unknowns: Canonical label mapping and source-population equivalence need source investigation. The three unmatched paths are not explained by drive/separator normalization in diagnostic checks. No wrong semantic source role is established.

data_leakage.comparison_establishes: Fourteen extra members and one paired path/volume mismatch remain under the frozen unordered-list and Windows-path rules.
data_leakage.supported_generic_cause: List-population disagreement after the declared path normalization.
data_leakage.interpretation: Reordering changes which nonmatching member the deterministic unordered assignment pairs as the single path mismatch. One value swaps between mismatch and extra categories; combined wrong values are unchanged.
data_leakage.unknowns: Audit does not establish that additional retained paths are forensically false or that the reference population is exhaustive. Intended list scope needs source review.

data_leakage.comparison_establishes: One literal note-text string mismatch under the frozen case/whitespace comparison.
data_leakage.diagnostic_relation: Unicode compatibility normalization (NFKC) yields equality; canonical normalization (NFC) does not.
data_leakage.limits: NFKC is not enabled by this frozen matcher. Diagnostic equality is not a harmlessness or forensic-equivalence judgment.

data_leakage.comparison_establishes: One storage path and two identifiers fail string comparison. A separate required size is absent and is missing, not one of the twenty-seven wrong atoms.
data_leakage.diagnostic_relation: Storage paths agree after drive qualification is removed. Both identifier pairs agree after GUID braces are removed.
data_leakage.supported_generic_cause: Drive-qualification and identifier-brace representation discrepancies. Public size role is unsupported.
data_leakage.limits: These field canonicalizations are not enabled; diagnostic relations do not prove source identity or authorize repair.
